---
title: 'Not reported — Static estimator, other specifications'
format: html
---

```{r}
pacman::p_load(tidyverse, arrow, here, DIDmultiplegtSTAT)

data_quarterly <- read_parquet(here("data", "data_quarterly.parquet"))
data_monthly <- read_parquet(here("data", "data_monthly.parquet"))
```

## Quarterly panel

### M1: Main specification

```{r}
q_m1 <- did_multiplegt_stat(
  df = data_quarterly,
  Y = "n_installations_per_1000",
  ID = "id",
  Time = "time",
  D = "treatment",
  exact_match = TRUE,
  placebo = TRUE
)
print(q_m1)
```

### M3: Explicit WAOSS

```{r}
q_m3 <- did_multiplegt_stat(
  df = data_quarterly,
  Y = "n_installations_per_1000",
  ID = "id",
  Time = "time",
  D = "treatment",
  estimator = "waoss",
  exact_match = TRUE,
  placebo = TRUE
)
print(q_m3)
```

### M4: AOSS and WAOSS

```{r}
q_m4 <- did_multiplegt_stat(
  df = data_quarterly,
  Y = "n_installations_per_1000",
  ID = "id",
  Time = "time",
  D = "treatment",
  estimator = c("aoss", "waoss"),
  exact_match = TRUE,
  placebo = TRUE
)
print(q_m4)
```

### M5: Test AOSS = WAOSS

```{r}
q_m5 <- did_multiplegt_stat(
  df = data_quarterly,
  Y = "n_installations_per_1000",
  ID = "id",
  Time = "time",
  D = "treatment",
  estimator = c("aoss", "waoss"),
  exact_match = TRUE,
  aoss_vs_waoss = TRUE,
  placebo = TRUE
)
print(q_m5)
```
